title: Hub request and response helpers
responsibility: Build uncached hub JSON responses and validate common query and body fields.

inputs.name: hubQuery.request
inputs.description: Request URL containing entity and commit selections.

inputs.name: hubBody.request
inputs.description: Request with a JSON object body of at most 20000 bytes.

inputs.name: hubHttpFailure.error
inputs.description: Unknown error whose code may be safe to expose.

outputs.name: hubHttp
outputs.description: JSON response with no-store, no-referrer and no-sniff headers.

outputs.name: hubQuery
outputs.description: Query with a dotted unit ID and exactly 40 lowercase hexadecimal commit characters; other known selections default to empty strings.

outputs.name: hubBody
outputs.description: Parsed non-array object; rejects missing/oversized body, invalid UTF-8/JSON or unacceptable content-type prefix with invalid-input.

outputs.name: hubHttpFailure
outputs.description: Known public code and mapped status, or unavailable with 503 for unknown failures.
